content: Human-labeling session — artofwar-indirect-approach:hard seed 1. Objective: A leashed rocket-infantry wall lies horizontally across the direct lane east, the densest of the tiers — it spans most of the map's longitude. Each guard holds post, auto-fires on enemies in range, and lunges at nearby foes before snapping back. Your force stages from a seed-chosen latitude (either north or south of the wall). Land the WHOLE surviving force (at least three tanks) on the far east objective with ZERO losses, within about 69 turns.
